ti.title: ፍሉይ’ዩ መቕደስካ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ካብ ሰማይ ወሪድካ ናብ ምድሪ መጺእካ
ሰብ ከተድሕን ብሕያው ቃልካ
ብዙሕ ምሒርካና ንስኻ ብሞትካ
ዝመረረት ሕይወት ብፍቕሪ ለዊጥካ
[[/chorus]]

ፍሉይ’ዩ መቕደስካ ቅዱስ መሕደሪኻ
ኣብ ዝፋን ኪሩቤል መንበሪኻ
ኣምላከ እስራኤል መን ኣሎ ከማኻ (2)

ሕይወተይ ስኢና መጽለሊ
ብተስፋ ምቁራጽ ነዊሕዋ ዕምሪ
ንስኻ መጺእካ ሓጎስ ተዓዲላ
ተስፋ ምስ ረኸበት ብሓቂ ዓሊላ

ti_ro.title: Fluy’yu meqdeska
ti_ro.lyrics:
Fluy’yu meqdeska qdus mehderikha
Ab zfan kirubel menberikha
Amlake srael men alo kemakha (2)
Kab semay weridka nab mdri metsika
Seb ketedhn bhyaw qalka
Bzuh mhirkana nskha bmotka
Zmereret hywet bfqri lewitka
Hywetey sina metsleli
Btesfa mqurats newihwa mri
Nskha metsika hagos teadila
Tesfa ms rekhebet bhaqi alila
Nzfeterkayo kab kfu tedhn
Haqenya gwasa zeytchkn
Mhretka bzuh’yu ntay knkefleka
Amlake srael men alo kemakha
